# If the S program cannot be started, the recipe fails like any other
# (saying why), and its F recipe file is still removed.
mkdir tmp
env TMPDIR=$WORK/tmp
env XDG_RUNTIME_DIR=
! mk -p 1 missing
stderr 'recipe for ''missing'' failed: exec: "no-such-program-xyz": executable file not found'
exec ls tmp
! stdout .

# with -k, other targets are still built
! mk -k -p 1 missing other
stdout '^other ran$'

-- mkfile --
missing:VFSno-such-program-xyz:
	print("never")

other:V:
	echo other ran
